title: Three Seasons and One Short Net
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：voyage　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 voyage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1995 the fisherman ① made the voyage that no boatman in the harbour would have described, and he said the making was the whole of the season. The ② voyage, meaning the journey itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; a voyage, he said, is the only thing in a harbour that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ voyage in that harbour had the same short net beside it, and the ④ voyage at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A voyage, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the fisherman said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the voyage was the whole of the matter, meaning the courage and not the journey. The ⑥ voyage, meaning the courage and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; voyage, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a journey and a courage. He said the courage is the part they remember.

By 2000 the ⑦ voyage had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ voyage of the whole thing, the fisherman wrote in July, was one harbour and three seasons of describing; voyage, he said, is either the catch at the far pier or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ voyage I remember is the journey described in the logbook, which closed in 2002 and is still described as the quietest in the harbour. A ⑩ voyage, my mother said in 2004, is the only journey that improves by being described; every voyage, she said, is a courage that has agreed to look like a journey. She said the courage was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 航行；旅程（指渔港里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 航行；旅程（指那次航行本身，与小小的渔网相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the voyage 踏上这一次航行
D. n. 航行；旅程（指留给孩子们起的那一网）
E. n. 航行之事（抽象总称，指一处渔港的航行之事）
F. n. 航行；旅程（指航海日志里写到、被描述的那一次）
G. n. 航行、胆识（指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 胆识（抽象总称，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the voyage that no boatman in the harbour would have described
The voyage, meaning the journey itself and not the net
the voyage at the far pier
the voyage was the whole of the matter
the voyage had become a line in a logbook
The voyage of the whole thing
A voyage, my mother said in 2004

answers.why: make the voyage 意为“踏上这一次航行”，1995 年那位渔人把渔港里没有一位船工肯描述的一次航行做了一遍。
voyage 意为“航行；旅程”，指那次航行本身而不是小小的渔网，它经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被描述。
voyage 意为“航行；旅程”，指渔港里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。
voyage 意为“航行；旅程”，指最远那座码头的留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
voyage 意为“航行、胆识”，指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次胆识就是那件事的全部。
voyage 意为“胆识”，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次航行，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
voyage 意为“航行；旅程”，指航海日志里写到、被描述的那一次，到 2000 年这一次成了航海日志里的一行。
voyage 意为“航行之事”，渔人七月写道，整件事的航行之事是一处渔港和三个汛期的描述。
voyage 意为“航行；旅程”，我记得的是航海日志里描述过的那一次，2002 年归港了，至今仍被说成渔港里最安静的一次。
voyage 为抽象总称，母亲 2004 年说，航行是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的航行。
